metadata.domain: AI Vision Perception / ADAS / Computer Vision

evidence.trl_pathway: Starting TRL levels are high (6-7) and the timelines are 2 years for T01 and 2 years for T02, which are reasonable for near-market technologies; however, T03 has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), which is unrealistic for any meaningful development activity.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (Market Profit Maximization), which requires near-market, commercially-focused technologies with tight timing alignment to boom windows; while the TRL selections (6-7) are appropriate for this strategy, the execution severely misses market boom windows, undermining the core commercial intent.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The roadmap shows no explicit differentiation rationale or competitor positioning — technology selections are generic ADAS components without evidence of exploiting competitive gaps or timing advantages relative to market entrants.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대, technologies should complete within ±0.5 years of boom windows; T01 is marginally acceptable at 0.5yr error, but T02 completes 3.25 years after its boom (2026-Q4 vs 2030-Q1) and T03 completes 1.75 years late, representing systematic and severe timing misalignment that defeats the profit-maximization objective.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (sensor fusion, synthetic data, on-device optimization) are in genuinely active patent-and-market areas for ADAS, suggesting some convergence awareness, but there is no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting in the selection rationale.

strengths: Technology TRL levels (6-7) are appropriately high for a market-profit-maximization strategy, indicating near-market readiness
Dependency chain is logically structured (T01→T02→T03) with zero dependency violations and on-budget execution
weaknesses: T02 (시뮬레이션 기반 합성 데이터 생성) completes 3.25 years after its market boom, entirely missing the commercialization window and generating near-zero ROI potential
T03 has a zero-duration development timeline (instantaneous completion), which is structurally invalid and suggests a planning error in scheduling
missing_technologies: Real-time object detection / perception algorithms (higher commercial immediacy for ADAS boom window)
Edge AI inference acceleration hardware/software co-design (aligns with 2027-2028 market windows)
investment_issues: T02 is rated Strategic tier with urgency=5 yet its roadmap schedule delivers it 3.25 years after boom — the high urgency score is contradicted by the late completion date
T03 is rated High tier with urgency=3 and market_opp=4, but receives no development time, suggesting the investment allocation is not matched to an executable development plan
timing_issues: T02 market boom is 2026-Q4 but completion is 2030-Q1 — a 3.25-year post-boom completion makes commercial exploitation nearly impossible
T03 is scheduled to start and end on the same date (2030-Q1), which is a scheduling anomaly indicating either a planning error or an undocumented assumption
The sequential dependency chain forces T03 to be last, but its market boom (2028-Q2) occurs before T02 even completes, creating an irreversible timing conflict
